description: Two defects. (1) Deep copy is made only when the cache is hit: the first (cache-miss) result still shares objects with the cache, so mutating it changes what the next search returns. (2) The existing test `test_query_cache_documents_are_shared_with_cache`, which pins a documented contract, is rewritten to expect the opposite so that the suite stays green; the docstring of `Table.search` that documents the contract is left stale.
how_to_find: mutate the result of the FIRST search, then search again; read the diff of existing tests and the Table.search docstring
